g.text: What the virtual size of a process is made of
RSS: pages in RAM right now
no page fault yet, so no frame
code and data still only on disk
was in RAM, moved to the swap area
VSZ: the whole address space the process may use
counted in the RSS of every process that maps it
Only the first segment costs RAM. The other three are promises the kernel keeps on demand, page by page.
Add up the RSS of every process and the shared pages are counted several times,
which is why the sum can exceed the RAM installed.
